Job Description: Title: Administrative Assistant (Toimistosihteeri) Company: Spectacular AI Location: Helsinki Region, Finland URL: https://fi.indeed.com/rc/clk?jk=7489a1e63f425d9d Posted: N/A Deadline: 2026-08-31 Reason: Part-time administrative role with invoicing, HR support, and general assistance — a strong match for Manju's background. ======================================== JOB DESCRIPTION: ======================================== Privacy Policy Job Openings Administrative Assistant (Toimistosihteeri) Espoo, Uusimaa Location: Espoo (In-person) Commitment: Part-time (2 days / week) Start Date: August or September 2026 Spectacular AI is currently a small, highly technical team specializing in drone navigation technology. As we grow, we need a reliable part-time Administrative Assistant to help the management with essential paperwork such as invoicing, time sheets, receipts, and potentially participate in other business functions such as customer support. Core Responsibilities Finance & Accounting: Sending out invoices to customers, processing receipts and bills in Procountor, and keeping track of expenses. HR Support: Managing staff benefits (like lunch vouchers), keeping track of holidays and sick leaves, and reporting these to our payroll service. General Help: Assisting with document management, travel bookings, meeting arrangements, and occasional customer support tasks as needed. What We Offer A relaxed but professional small-team environment. The chance to be a key part of our growth from a small startup to a larger team. Flexible part-time work and competitive pay. Requirements Computer Skills: You are comfortable using a laptop and basic tools like email, Google Docs, Excel, Slack, video calls, and administrative web services (for example, Procountor) Fluent in English and Finnish. Readiness to relocate to the Helsinki region, Finland for in-person work in our Espoo office. Legal right to work in the EU.  Ideal Extras The following skills, qualifications and experience are not mandatory but highly valued Earlier experience or education (AMK, BSc, or MSc) in a relevant field like business, HR, or accounting. Especially prior experience in similar roles. A proactive attitude — you enjoy keeping things organized and helping out where needed. Technical abilities: good computer skills (better than the minimum required level) and general interest in technology are counted as a plus. paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Administrative Assistant position at Spectacular AI. With my background in legal coordination and event management, I believe I can contribute significantly to your team.

My experience in coordinating large-scale events, managing logistics, and liaising with stakeholders aligns perfectly with the general assistance you seek. At International House Oulu, I successfully managed 14 community events, averaging 25 international participants each, showcasing my organizational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

I am fluent in Finnish (B2 level) and English, which will enable me to communicate effectively within your team and with external stakeholders. My proficiency in both languages, along with my native Malayalam language, allows me to bridge communication gaps across diverse groups.
I am available to start work in the Helsinki region as soon as possible and look forward to contributing to Spectacular AI's growth journey. Thank you for considering my application.
